title: GTA 6 Can't Completely Sweep This Year's GOTY Awards
description: GTA 6 has officially missed out on the Golden Joysticks awards for 2026. Find out why the timing means it can't win Console Game of the Year.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Misses Out on 2026 Golden Joysticks Awards

For fans anticipating the launch of *GTA 6*, the race for the ultimate Game of the Year (GOTY) accolades has always been a major talking point. However, according to a recent report by gaming outlet Push Square, there is one major GOTY-related milestone that *GTA 6* will not be able to sweep in 2026: the Golden Joysticks.

### Why GTA 6 Is Missing from the Lineup

The Golden Joysticks has officially revealed its lineup of nominees for each accolade it has to offer, and *GTA 6* is notably absent from the list. The reason behind this omission comes down to strict scheduling.

The awards show takes place **eight days before** the game is even officially released. At the time of the ceremony, reviewers will still be in the process of playing and evaluating the massive open-world title.

Furthermore, the logistics of the event dictate that nominations for the awards had to be submitted well in advance—specifically by **August 28th**. With the submission deadline falling long before the game's launch window and review period, inclusion was practically impossible.

### What This Means for the Awards Season

As one of the industry's most prominent fan-voted award ceremonies, the Golden Joysticks serves as a major bellwether for the gaming year. Because of the calendar alignment, *GTA 6* cannot win accolades such as the Console Game of the Year at this specific event.

While missing out on this particular ceremony due to a date conflict is a straightforward logistical reality rather than a reflection of the game's quality, it does mean the upcoming awards season will have to navigate a landscape where one of the most anticipated titles of the decade sits out this specific contest.

### Editor's Take
Missing the Golden Joysticks due to a scheduling conflict is hardly a setback for a juggernaut like *GTA 6*. While it prevents a clean sweep of every single 2026 accolade, the game's true legacy will be decided by its quality upon launch rather than early award cutoffs. The countdown continues regardless.
